requirements.title: Foundation Course (3 credits)
requirements.sourceText: Select one course from the following: AAS 220 - China: Language and Culture 3 credits; AAS 223 - China: Society and Civilization 3 credits; AAS 228 - China: History and Geography 3 credits

requirements.title: Chinese Language Courses (6-7 credits)
requirements.sourceText: Two Chinese language courses, the equivalent of CHI 112 or higher, are required from the following (6-7 credits): CHI 101 - Intensive Elementary Chinese 6 credits; CHI 112 - Elementary Chinese II 4 credits; CHI 120 - Elementary Chinese for Heritage Speakers 4 credits; CHI 201 - Intensive Intermediate Chinese 6 credits; CHI 211 - Intermediate Chinese I 3 credits; CHI 212 - Intermediate Chinese II 3 credits; CHI 220 - Intermediate Chinese for Heritage Speakers 3 credits; CHI 311 - Advanced Chinese I 3 credits; CHI 312 - Advanced Chinese II 3 credits; CHI 410 - Business Chinese 3 credits; CHI 411 - Readings in Journalistic Chinese 3 credits; CHI 412 - Readings in Classical Chinese 3 credits; CHI 421 - Chinese Poetry and Short Stories 3 credits; CHI 422 - Chinese Lyric Prose and Plays 3 credits; CHI 426 - Structure of Mandarin Chinese 3 credits; CHI 447 - Directed Readings in Chinese 1-6 credits; CHI 487 - Supervised Research in Chinese 0-3 credits

notes.text: Director of the Minor: Yi Wang. Students should consult the Director of China Studies before studying abroad.

Students may fulfill the language requirement by taking Chinese courses offered by the Department of Asian and Asian American Studies on the SBU campus or department-approved study-abroad courses overseas.
Courses used to complete Requirement 2 (Chinese language courses) may not also be used to complete Requirement 3 (elective courses).

Some courses are crosslisted with at least one other academic department. Students earn credit by registering for either course but may not repeat the course by enrolling a second time under the other option.
